contexts.text: The Spirits of the ureters, etc. infest (those of the peritoneum). Described. SE 991.

In the middle of the series are the ureters... They speak with a harsh voice as if cracked, and desire to introduce themselves into the body; but it is only an endeavour... Those (of them) who relate to the ureters are to the left further from the body... This is one general way to the Hells. (Fully quoted under Kidney.) SE 825.
Under Kidney, see this reference. AC 5382. AC 5383. AC 5384. SE 1239.
For the ureters and bladder, which go forth from the kidneys, = exterior truth and its exploration, and also its castigation.
Those who constitute the province of... the ureters. SE 959.

The case is similar as respects... the ureters, which are in the folds of the peritoneum, and are castigated, and are kept in compliance; but it casts forth to the ureters the unclean things, or phlegms.
Those who represent the ureters, and in fact the grosser serosities.
